result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely lacking, with no sidewalks or marked crossings, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved grass. Large physical obstructions like a boat and trailer on the shoulder further compromise safety by blocking sightlines and narrowing the available space.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk in the street or on unpaved, uneven grass due to the total lack of a dedicated walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left side of the roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A boat and large trailer block the view of the intersection for both drivers and pedestrians, increasing collision risk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the road, adjacent to the brick building

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and crumbling of the asphalt surface creates trip hazards and uneven footing.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, paved sidewalk separated from the roadway to provide a safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings at the intersection to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Clear Sight Triangles
interventions.description: Enforce parking and storage regulations to remove large obstructions from the public right-of-way near intersections.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by poorly maintained, cracked sidewalks and significant physical obstructions, including a utility pole placed directly in the walkway. The intersection lacks basic safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian signals, creating a hostile environment for those with mobility challenges.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A large wooden utility pole is situated in the middle of the sidewalk, severely restricting the clear path for pedestrians and making it impassable for wheelchairs.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The concrete sidewalk is heavily cracked, uneven, and crumbling, presenting a significant trip hazard.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or curb ramps at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross unmarked pavement without designated priority.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large trees and utility poles at the corner block visibility between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction and Widening
interventions.description: Repair the cracked pavement and widen the sidewalk to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant clear path around existing utilities.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way at the intersection.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile warning strips and sloped curb ramps to provide accessible transitions from the sidewalk to the roadway.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove or trim vegetation and ensure no parking is allowed near the corner to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection that lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, signals, or stop signs. While sidewalks are present, the wide, unmarked roadway and poor pavement condition create a hostile environment for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross an wide, uncontrolled roadway without designated space.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Significant cracking and degradation of the asphalt surface can create trip hazards and affect vehicle braking.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are visible to regulate vehicle movement at this intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Control Evaluation
interventions.description: Evaluate the need for stop signs or other traffic calming measures to manage vehicle speeds and right-of-way.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, unmarked roadway and poorly maintained sidewalks. The lack of designated crossing infrastructure and the presence of sidewalk obstructions create a hostile environment for people walking.
